In this tutorial, I'll show you how to create a Twitter bot using R that automatically generates and posts "Would You Rather" questions.

This project demonstrates how to:
- Set up Twitter API credentials
- Use the `rtweet` package for Twitter integration
- Create automated content generation
- Schedule regular posts

::: {.callout-warning}
Note: Twitter's API policies have changed significantly since this post was written. Be sure to check current API terms and conditions before implementing a Twitter bot.
:::
